We wish to inform you that 1,00,00,000 (One Crore) equity shares have been issued and allotted pursuant to the conversion of fully paid-up warrants into an equal number of equity shares, in the following three tranches:
Tranche I: 39,25,000 equity shares allotted on March 19, 2026 Tranche II: 54,47,222 equity shares allotted on March 27, 2026 Tranche III: 6,27,778 equity shares allotted on April 08, 2026
Out of the aforesaid 1,00,00,000 (One Crore) equity shares, 50,77,778 equity shares have been issued and allotted to the Promoter, Mr. Rohan Gupta, pursuant to the conversion of the fully paid-up warrants held by him, as detailed below:
Tranche I: 19,25,000 equity shares allotted on March 19, 2026 Tranche II: 28,25,000 equity shares allotted on March 27, 2026 Tranche III: 3,27,778 equity shares allotted on April 08, 2026
The process for obtaining the requisite Trading Approval from the Stock Exchanges and completing the necessary Corporate Action in respect of the aforesaid equity shares is currently underway.
Further, the total number of members of the Promoter Group has increased pursuant to the acquisition of 15,50,000 equity shares by Mr. Sanjay Gupta by way of gift on April 27, 2026. As Mr. Sanjay Gupta is an immediate relative of the Promoters, he has been classified as a member of the Promoter Group in accordance with the SEBI Regulations.
